adacheung.name: Professor Ada Cheung
adacheung.title: Prof / Endocrinologist
adacheung.practice: Prof Ada Cheung - Endocrinologist (private rooms, Heidelberg)
adacheung.description: Endocrinologist at Equinox Endocrinology, which provides "specialist hormone care for trans and gender diverse adults aged 18 and over across Victoria" - weekly, in person or telehealth, time-limited (max five visits per referral) before ongoing care returns to the GP. For people who have not yet started gender affirming hormone therapy, or already on hormones needing a one-off specialist consult. GP referral required; "all visits are bulk billed with no out of pocket costs" with Medicare. Also consults privately (scope includes "Trans and Gender Diverse Health") and in the Austin Health Transgender Clinic.
adacheung.specialties: Trans and gender diverse health, gender-affirming hormone therapy, androgen deprivation therapy, thyroid, osteoporosis, pituitary, adrenal

ingridbretherton.name: Dr Ingrid Bretherton
ingridbretherton.title: Dr / Endocrinologist
ingridbretherton.description: She has an interest in all aspects of general endocrinology and diabetes and has a special interest in transgender medicine and treating endocrine and diabetes issues during pregnancy. She is currently investigating the effects of hormone therapy on bone health in trans and gender diverse individuals. Special interests: Diabetes: Type 1 diabetes mellitus, Type 2 diabetes mellitus, Gestational diabetes, MODY, Endocrine: Transgender health, Endocrine disorders in pregnancy, Thyroid and parathyroid disease, Osteoporosis and bone health, Pituitary disease, Adrenal disease, Sodium and calcium disorders. Women’s health: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), Bone health, Men’s health: Low testosterone, Androgen replacement therapy , Bone Health. Weight management/ weight loss.
ingridbretherton.specialties: Transgender health, gender-affirming hormone therapy, bone health, general adult endocrinology

Private billing practice (bulk billing only for some pensioner/HCC groups). Site lists 18 GPs (Richard Moore, Ruth McNair AM, Cate Sheppard, Jeff Willcox, Kelvin Adams, Katriona Hill, Gini Skinner, David Spencer, Will Mitchell, Natalia Rode, Katherine Thornton, Lauren Maisey, Dustin Sprigg, Jacqui Lee, Daniel Wong, Aurora Killey, Darcy O'Connell, Emily Thrower) but does not say which prescribe.
